# Installed with --no-deps after requirements.txt. Each one declares a
# dependency the environment deliberately leaves out:
# - ultralytics and hand_tracking_toolkit declare opencv-python, which would
#   install a second cv2 over opencv-python-headless.
# - hamer declares detectron2, mmcv==1.3.9, chumpy and xtcocotools, used only by
#   its demo (ViTDet person detector, ViTPose) and by MANO pickles that the
#   environment replaces with chumpy-free copies (tools/models/mano_dechumpy.py).
ultralytics==8.4.6
hand_tracking_toolkit @ git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/hand_tracking_toolkit@bc628e9286c18444b47a0971a89d075ea6f00747
hamer @ git+https://github.com/geopavlakos/hamer@3a01849f4148352e9260b69bf28b65d1671a4905
